item.title: Christa Pike Saw Her as a Threat. Then Everything Escalated
item.description: Christa Pike became consumed by jealousy over a romantic rivalry. What followed was a brutal confrontation that turned a personal conflict into one of Tennessee’s most disturbing true crime cases.
